Done. All three functions are implemented and exported:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js – converts byte counts to B/KB/MB/GB format with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js – converts titles to URL-safe slugs (lowercase, trim, spaces→dashes, strip non-alphanumeric)
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js – fetches users from `/api/users`, logs the count, and returns the array
